player_description:
MARS VIDET OMNIA

---

I did not want to do this.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 3, when the party finds the message carved into a tree at the edge of their camp.
HOW: Jagged strip of paper. Latin line written with steady strokes, second line scratched lightly with a dull blade.
WHAT IT REVEALS: Someone in the party — PC or NPC under corruption's influence — carved this message without full awareness or against their will. The Latin is too clean and deliberate; the second line was added by a hand barely in control. If a player has Corruption 3+, ask them privately after the session if it was them. If they say yes, play it out next session as a recovered memory. If no PC qualifies: it was Capsarius (Titus Vindex) — he filed a false medical report about the vault deaths and this is the spillover.
